$comment: The canonical pipeline. One source, machine-readable, and the thing everything else is
generated from: SKILL.md's build process, the command vocabulary, and the provider
packages for Claude, Codex and Cursor.
Two rules are encoded here rather than described elsewhere.
ORDER IS THE DESIGN. Evidence precedes direction; direction precedes the contract. Fixing
tokens before a direction is chosen is how nine subjects with different evidence packs
converged on one look — measured, twice, in docs/v2/LEGACY-VISUAL-AUDIT.md and
PROGRESSIVE DISCLOSURE IS MANDATORY. `reads` is what a step loads and nothing more. An
ordinary task must never pull the whole rule set or the 1.4 MB of data into context. The
`alwaysLoaded` list below is the entire standing cost.

commands.$comment: Seven verbs, fewer than any competitor, each bound to a span of the pipeline. impeccable declares roughly twenty-three; a vocabulary a user cannot hold is a vocabulary they do not use.

init.summary: Understand the subject and what already exists. Produces BRIEF.md, EVIDENCE.md, BRAND.md, ASSET-MANIFEST.md, VISUAL-SOURCE-PLAN.md.

shape.summary: Make the assets the plan calls for, then three contrasting directions, one chosen with reasons, then the contract and the interaction contract written from the winner.

build.summary: Section order, the pages, and the journeys that exercise them.

audit.summary: Does it work, does it render the direction it chose, is it its own site, and is it finished.

harden.summary: Close the states and the assets. Re-run what the audit failed.

polish.summary: The visual judgement, then the one round of work it names.

doctor.summary: Is the installation itself correct: paths, dependencies, version drift, canonical/provider sync.

steps.name: Brief and existing repository
steps.note: Items 1 to 6 of the done list. If two readings lead to materially different sites, ask one question; otherwise infer, write it down and proceed.

steps.name: Inspect what exists
steps.note: Framework, styling system, tokens, component library, CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / README, existing assets. An established stack is a decision already made. Adopt it.

steps.name: Evidence pack
steps.note: Research, not design. Nothing here picks a colour. A direction reachable without this file did not need it.

steps.name: Brand and asset inventory
steps.note: What the subject already owns, before anything is invented. A client with a logo, a palette and a photo library hands them over here or nowhere.

steps.name: Asset plan
steps.note: What each picture is for, before anything is sourced or generated. Two assignment-blinded reviewers scored assets the lowest criterion on all three round-7 builds while every picture was correctly sourced, licensed and cropped — so the gap was here, one step earlier than the sourcing engine. One block per asset: what it carries, whose job from the brief it serves, how it is used. A page whose visitor is choosing between things needs an asset that puts the options in one frame. No component is mandatory; the plan is. Re-checked at the production gate against DIRECTION.md and the manifest.

steps.name: Visual source plan
steps.note: Written before anything is generated, so the brief decides the picture rather than the picture deciding the brief. Every field is required; a blank factual-risk fails.

steps.name: Make the assets
steps.note: Capability routing, never a hardcoded tool name. Reuse and licensed material come before generation. A cost preflight prints before any paid call and spends nothing; with no provider at all, write ASSET-REQUESTS.md and stay a draft.

steps.name: Visual comps
steps.note: Rendered pages using real copy. 15 to 20 minutes each: a comp that takes an hour is a page, and building a page before the direction is chosen is what this step exists to prevent.

steps.name: Reasoned choice and rejections
produces: DIRECTION.md (with the verbatim axis record from v2/20-direction-lab.md)
steps.note: Scores, the winner, the signature-selector, and both rejections with a specific reason each. The axis record has a fixed machine-readable shape and direction-fidelity parses it: five  lines plus signature-selector and signature-min-share. Prose headings do not parse, and the gate then fails the page for declaring nothing.

steps.name: Design-system contract
steps.note: Written FROM the winning comp — its ground, its type, its rhythm — not the comp adjusted to fit a contract that already existed.

steps.name: Interaction contract
steps.note: Primary actions with observable outcomes, states and how each is reached, keyboard and focus. A state with no way in is deleted or wired.

steps.name: Stack-specific implementation
steps.note: Blocks supply structure, semantics, states and responsive behaviour — never the look. Where a stack is detected in `inspect`, its adapter notes are read here and nowhere else.

steps.name: Direction fidelity
steps.note: Measured in the browser's default colour scheme, because that is what a screenshot shows and a reviewer scores.

steps.name: Portfolio diversity
steps.note: Only when the project is one of several. A single site cannot repeat itself.

steps.name: Production gate
steps.gate: scripts/asset-plan.mjs check ASSET-PLAN.md --manifest ASSET-MANIFEST.md --direction DIRECTION.md && scripts/production-gate.mjs <url> --manifest ASSET-MANIFEST.md --mode <M|E|P> --production

steps.name: Visual critique
steps.note: On screenshots, blind, and only once the technical gate is green: a broken layout cannot be assessed for art direction.

steps.name: Targeted polish
steps.note: One round, driven by the criticisms the review actually made. Not a second design pass.

steps.name: Production report
steps.note: All fourteen of the done list, what changed, what could not be done, and every gate's verdict. The honest record, including failures.

principles.$comment: Adopted from the four audited repositories. Principles, not text; see docs/v2/FINAL-COMPETITOR-AUDIT.md and NOTICE.md.
from-taste-skill: guided variation across density, motion and boldness
image-first work and a reference board when the brief needs one
the brandkit as a step, not an afterthought
from-ui-ux-pro-max: structured design intelligence rather than invention
one canonical source for provider packages
from-frontend-design: design from the subject's actual world
few high-impact motion moments rather than animation everywhere
from-impeccable: init, shape, build, audit, harden, polish
a workflow for improving existing sites
